name: Rack focus
description: A fake lens pull: the room behind the speaker slides out of focus and darkens a little while the speaker stays sharp, with a slow push in. Then it racks back.
when: When you want focus on you for one line: a key point, a confession, a quiet moment.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
a clean plate: the room without the speaker (plate.png)
